chunks: You will remember what I say to you; I submit my case to God. Surely God is Seer of the servants.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to submit one's affair to God in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Fussilat, this verse is often cited by Shia scholars to illustrate the Prophet's (and by extension, the Imams') practice of 'Tafwid' during times of opposition, emphasizing that divine justice does not require immediate human intervention. It underscores the theological principle that Allah's 'Basir' (All-Seeing) nature ensures that the truth spoken will eventually be recognized by those who initially rejected it, validating the patience of the righteous.
